concepts.label: Actuality
concepts.definition: Recording of an event

concepts.label: Advertiser Supplied
concepts.definition: Content is supplied by an organisation or individual that has paid the news provider for its placement

concepts.label: Advice
concepts.definition: Letters and answers about readers' personal problems

concepts.label: Advisory
concepts.definition: Recommendation on editorial or technical matters by a provider to its customers

concepts.label: Analysis
concepts.definition: Data and conclusions drawn by a journalist who has conducted in depth research for a story

concepts.label: Anniversary
concepts.definition: Stories about the anniversary of some important event that took place in recent history, usually bringing a short review of the event itself.

concepts.label: Archival material
concepts.definition: Material selected from the originator's archive that has been previously distributed

concepts.label: Background
concepts.definition: Scene setting and explanation for an event being reported

concepts.label: Behind the Story
concepts.definition: The content describes how a story was reported and offers context on the reporting

concepts.label: Biography
concepts.definition: Facts and background about a person

concepts.label: Birth Announcement
concepts.definition: News of newly born children

concepts.label: Current Events
concepts.definition: Content about events taking place at the time of the report

concepts.label: Curtain Raiser
concepts.definition: Information about the staging and outcome of an immediately upcoming event

concepts.label: Daybook
concepts.definition: Items filed on a regular basis that are lists of upcoming events with time and place, designed to inform others of events for planning purposes.

concepts.label: Exclusive
concepts.definition: Information content, in any form, that is unique to a specific information provider.

concepts.label: Fact Check
concepts.definition: The news item looks into the truth or falsehood of another reported news item or assertion (for example a statement on social media by a public figure)

concepts.label: Feature
concepts.definition: The object content is about a particular event or individual that may not be significant to the current breaking news.

concepts.label: Fixture
concepts.definition: The object contains data that occurs often and predictably.

concepts.label: Forecast
concepts.definition: The object contains opinion as to the outcome of a future event.

concepts.label: From the Scene
concepts.definition: The object contains a report from the scene of an event.

concepts.label: Help us to Report
concepts.definition: The news item is a call for readers to provide information that may help journalists to investigate a potential news story

concepts.label: History
concepts.definition: The object content is based on previous rather than current events.

concepts.label: Horoscope
concepts.definition: Astrological forecasts

concepts.label: Interview
concepts.definition: The object contains a report of a dialogue with a news source that gives it significant voice (includes Q and A).

concepts.label: Listing of facts
concepts.definition: Detailled listing of facts related to a topic or a story

concepts.label: Music
concepts.definition: The object contains music alone.

concepts.label: Obituary
concepts.definition: The object contains a narrative about an individual's life and achievements for publication after his or her death.

concepts.label: On This Day
concepts.definition: List of data, including birthdays of famous people and items of historical significance, for a given day

concepts.label: Opinion
concepts.definition: The object contains an editorial comment that reflects the views of the author.

concepts.label: Polls and Surveys
concepts.definition: The object contains numeric or other information produced as a result of questionnaires or interviews.

concepts.label: Press Release
concepts.definition: The object contains promotional material or information provided to a news organisation.

concepts.label: Press-Digest
concepts.definition: The object contains an editorial comment by another medium completely or in parts without significant journalistic changes.

concepts.label: Profile
concepts.definition: The object contains a description of the life or activity of a news subject (often a living individual).

concepts.label: Program
concepts.definition: A news item giving lists of intended events and time to be covered by the news provider. Each program covers a day, a week, a month or a year. The covered period is referenced as a keyword.

concepts.label: Question and Answer Session
concepts.definition: The object contains the interviewer and subject questions and answers.

concepts.label: Quote
concepts.definition: The object contains a one or two sentence verbatim in direct quote.

concepts.label: Raw Sound
concepts.definition: The object contains unedited sounds.

concepts.label: Response to a Question
concepts.definition: The object contains a reply to a question.

concepts.label: Results Listings and Statistics
concepts.definition: The object contains alphanumeric data suitable for presentation in tabular form.

concepts.label: Retrospective
concepts.definition: The object contains material that looks back on a specific (generally long) period of time such as a season, quarter, year or decade.

concepts.label: Review
concepts.definition: The object contains a critique of a creative activity or service (for example a book, a film or a restaurant).

concepts.label: Satire
concepts.definition: Uses exaggeration, irony, or humour to make a point; not intended to be understood as factual

concepts.label: Scener
concepts.definition: The object contains a description of the event circumstances.

concepts.label: Side bar and supporting information
concepts.definition: Related story that provides additional context or insight into a news event

concepts.label: Special Report
concepts.definition: In-depth examination of a single subject requiring extensive research and usually presented at great length, either as a single item or as a series of items

concepts.label: Sponsored
concepts.definition: Content is produced on behalf of an organisation or individual that has paid the news provider for production and may approve content publication

concepts.label: Summary
concepts.definition: Single item synopsis of a number of generally unrelated news stories

concepts.label: Supported
concepts.definition: Content is produced with financial support from an organisation or individual, yet not approved by the underwriter before or after publication

concepts.label: Synopsis
concepts.definition: The object contains a condensed version of a single news item.

concepts.label: Text only
concepts.definition: The object contains a transcription of text.

concepts.label: Transcript and Verbatim
concepts.definition: A word for word report of a discussion or briefing

concepts.label: Update
concepts.definition: The object contains an intraday snapshot (as for electronic services) of a single news subject.

concepts.label: Voicer
concepts.definition: Content is only voice

concepts.label: Wrap
concepts.definition: Complete summary of an event

concepts.label: Wrapup
concepts.definition: Recap of a running story
